feed.title: Nessel wants to hold PSC 'accountable' in fight against data center
feed.summary: Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel and environmental groups have filed arguments with the Michigan Court of Appeals challenging the Michigan Public Service Commission's (PSC) approval of contracts between DTE Energy Co. and developers of a hyperscale data center in Saline Township. Nessel argues the commissioners failed to provide evidence for their approval, used a fast-tracked process, ignored their own standards, and overlooked issues with DTE's cost calculations. She seeks to invalidate the approval and ensure future data center contracts face thorough scrutiny due to concerns about impact on residents and utility customers.
